items.followUp: State one way encryption protects information.

rubric.why: Identifies encryption’s purpose of protecting information.
rubric.description: States that encryption protects information from unauthorized access.
rubric.how: Award for naming security or explaining that encryption prevents unauthorized people from accessing the information.

rubric.why: Shows how encryption keeps information confidential.
rubric.description: Explains that encryption changes readable information into coded form.
rubric.how: Award for stating that plain text is converted into cipher text or an equivalent expression.

modelAnswer: Encryption provides security by protecting information from unauthorized access.
It converts readable plain text into coded cipher text, keeping the information confidential.
